component.name: White Screen
component.summary: Fill any monitor with a solid color

description.p: White Screen fills one or more of your monitors with a flat, uniform color. It is a purpose-built tool for the jobs where an ordinary maximized window is not good enough: no title bar, no shadows, no wallpaper bleeding through, and no cursor in the frame.

ul.li: Checking a panel for dead or stuck pixels
Inspecting LCD backlight bleed and clouding on a black or white field
Using a display as a soft key light for a webcam or camera
Eyeballing color uniformity and tint across several monitors

description.p: Pick a color from the presets or the full color picker, choose which monitors to cover, and the overlay appears on each of them. Press any key to dismiss it. The Identify button labels every screen with its connector name so you always know which physical panel you are looking at.

Cycle mode steps through white, black, red, green and blue on a timer, which is what a dead-pixel check needs — a stuck subpixel only shows up on some of them. The screen is kept awake while an overlay is up, so a display used as a key light does not blank partway through, and the color, the monitors and the interval are remembered for next time.

ul.li: Solid-color overlay on any combination of monitors
Color presets plus a full custom color picker
Identify mode showing each monitor's connector name
Optional indicator for external gamma / night-light filters
